capabilities: Paste Discord messages with usernames, timestamps and text into notes
Copy whole conversations, not just single messages
Convert Discord markdown to Obsidian markdown
Embed attachments, custom emojis and website links
Configure datetime format, replies, (edited) and system messages
disambiguation: Not a Discord integration that connects to the app; it only reformats messages already copied to the clipboard.
extras: README warns that about 10% of copies contain only raw text the plugin cannot parse, and that right-click copy never works because it lacks HTML.
problem: Copying Discord messages into a note normally yields scrambled raw text instead of structured, readable conversations.
summary: Paste Discord messages from the desktop client and have their usernames, timestamps, text and markdown converted to Obsidian formatting.
